This is clearly a stalk disease. Key candidates: Anthracnose_stalk_rot (black external stalk discoloration), Charcoal_stalk_rot (gray-black internal), Physoderma_stalk_rot.

The reference for Anthracnose_stalk_rot shows exactly the same pattern — dark black external discoloration of the stalk rind/epidermis, particularly visible in the bottom-left panel. The shiny black external coloring on the stalk is the hallmark of Anthracnose stalk rot (caused by *Colletotrichum graminicola*).

The test image matches perfectly: two corn stalks with extensive dark black/bluish-black external rind discoloration, with some yellowish patches remaining — classic Anthracnose stalk rot "black leg" appearance.
